# Vonage Business Communications APIs

Updated: 5/8/2026 2:13 PM

Our available Vonage Business Communications (VBC) APIs allow you to manipulate data and features on your VBC account. To apply these solutions, you must qualify and request a VBC API Developer's account.

While Vonage provides the infrastructure and documentation to power your builds, please note the following regarding implementation and support:

- **Self-Managed Integration**: These APIs are designed for use by your internal development team. Your developers are responsible for the configuration, testing, and ongoing maintenance of all VBC API integrations.
- **Support Scope**: Vonage support is limited to 1) facilitating access to the Developer Portal for qualifying accounts and 2) providing technical documentation. Vonage does not assist with coding, debugging, or the architectural design of your specific applications.

---

##### Available VBC APIs

VBC APIs use [OAuth](https://oauth.net/2/) for authentication, which is incompatible with Single Sign On (SSO). If your company uses this authentication method, you must create a separate user account that does not use SSO to implement VBC APIs.

| **API Category** | **Description** |
|---|---|
| **[Call Recording](https://developer.vonage.com/en/vonage-business-cloud/call-recording/overview?source=vonage-business-cloud)** | Download and delete company call recordings. |
| **[Provisioning](https://developer.vonage.com/en/vonage-business-cloud/provisioning/overview?source=vonage-business-cloud)** | Use to retrieve information about locations, users, and extensions on an account. |
| **[Reports](https://developer.vonage.com/en/vonage-business-cloud/reports/overview?source=vonage-business-cloud)** | Retrieve call logs for your account. |
| **[Telephony](https://developer.vonage.com/en/vonage-business-cloud/telephony/overview?source=vonage-business-cloud)** | Manage calls and retrieve device registration information. |
| **[Vonage Integration Platform](https://developer.vonage.com/en/vonage-business-cloud/vonage-integration-platform/overview?source=vonage-business-cloud)** | Enables call control and webhooks for call events. |

##### Request a VBC API Developer Account

1. Ensure your organization has 50 extensions or more.
2. Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) to explore eligibility and next steps. If you do not have a CSM, [Contact Support](https://businesssupport.vonage.com/contactus).

##### Troubleshoot Issues

**Cannot Sign In**
Confirm you have a VBC API Developer's account, and you are using the credentials provided in your Welcome Email.

| **Welcome Email?** | **Then...** |
|---|---|
| **Yes** | 1. Sign in to the [VBC Developer Portal](https://developer.vonage.com/en/vonage-business-cloud/getting-started/logging-in?source=vonage-business-cloud) with the username and password from your Welcome Email. 2. Select Vonage **Business Communications** from the **Platform** menu. |
| **No** | Check your junk email folder for the email, and if not found, contact your CSM. **Subj**: VBC Developer Center - Welcome **From**: Vonage Dev Support |

**Cannot Generate or**
**Use Access Tokens**
When you set up your VBC API Developers account in the portal, you must also create an API key with credentials that match those of your VBC user account.

1. Verify you are using the credentials for your VBC account (used to sign in to the Desktop App and/or Mobile App), not your VBC API Developers credentials.

While your Vonage API Developer credentials do not prevent the token creation, they do not allow access to the VBC APIs.

**NOTE**: Remember that SSO is not supported; you must create a separate VBC user account that does not use SSO to manage tokens and VBC APIs.
2. Confirm your token has not expired:
| **Access Token** | Access tokens expire after 24 hours (86400 seconds). Once an access token expires, you must use the refresh token with the refresh grant type to request a new access token. |
|---|---|
| **Refresh Token** | Refresh tokens expire after 7 days (604800 seconds). Once a refresh token is exchanged for an access token, a new refresh token is generated. If the refresh token is not used within the expiration window, you must authenticate again. |
**NOTE**: See [Authenticate to the Vonage Business Communications APIs](https://developer.vonage.com/en/vonage-business-cloud/getting-started/create-an-access-token?source=vonage-business-cloud) for details on how to create and refresh an Access Token.

**Experience Coding Issues**
Work with your internal developers to code and apply APIs; Vonage does not offer support for coding issues.
